board.check-ready.help:
check-ready — the judge of a card's readiness by the criterion's gates (no model calls).

  node .forma/board/check-ready.cjs card-NNN [--gate "<command>"] [--root <dir>]
  (the card argument - NNN, card-NNN or the full card name on the board)
  node .forma/board/check-ready.cjs --help

Gates: the `check:` clauses in the card's criterion (field 3 of the five-fields line of the Task zone), in the order of appearance,
then --gate in the order of the arguments. A `check:` clause runs to the nearest `;` or to the end of the criterion.
The green convention: the command's exit code 0 = green, not 0 = RED; the command's stdout - the fact for the dossier
(a truncation of {limit} characters, an empty stdout - stderr). A gate's command runs through the platform's shell, cwd - the root.

Exceptions - lines with `exception:` in the card's History zone, the line's form:
  exception: <what> — <why> — <who approved>
A red gate is skipped only if the line names the gate - by the address (gate-N, as in the dossier), by the command
whole or by the gate's keyword (the first meaningful token of the command: not an interpreter and not a flag; for
`node path/name.cjs` - the file name without the extension). The first fitting exception wins. The rule
fail-closed: the gate is not named - the gate stays RED.

The dossier (stdout): a line per gate - the status, the address, the command, the fact; for the skipped - the exception line
with a mark; then the verdict remainder (a criterion without `check:` clauses - what the script cannot decide), the verdict and
the paths ("bring gate N through" | "write an exception: into History").

Exit codes: 0 - all gates green or skipped by exceptions; 1 - there is a RED without an exception
(NOT READY); 2 - a runtime error (no card, no five fields, no gates).

gpa.default_description: A node of the Forma protocol:
gpa.delegate.spec: Call when the task must be sliced into cards: one card is one qualification.
gpa.delegate.kit: Call when the task needs kitting: the role, the access, the scripts, the Run profiles.
gpa.delegate.run: Call when the task is kitted and must be executed exactly as assigned.
gpa.delegate.core: Call when the cycle is closed and a verdict is needed: whether the end-image is reached, and who is at fault in it.
gpa.delegate.extractor: Call when exactly the requested thing must be pulled from the files, without decisions.
gpa.delegate.plumb-haiku: Call when it must be measured which role fits the scrubbed task.
gpa.delegate.asset-describer-haiku: Call when the prepared images must be described by the manifest.
